paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 25b, [as one] who was poor and became wealthy. He came before Rav Ashi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כה: gives Bava Batra 25b under the colon convention, without a fresh named-edition check in this lane. The poor-to-rich sequence remains the source’s assertion.
אתא לקמיה is Aramaic, he came before; no occasion is supplied. יונאה retains its final aleph as Yona'ah rather than silently becoming Yonah. Rav Ashi has full רב; Pappi has no supplied title.
